18:         /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
19:         assembly {
20:             let n := mload(a) // Length of `a`.
21:             mstore(a, 0) // For insertion sort's inner loop to terminate.
22:             let h := add(a, shl(5, n)) // High slot.
23:             let w := not(0x1f)
24:             for { let i := add(a, 0x20) } 1 {} {
25:                 i := add(i, 0x20)
26:                 if gt(i, h) { break }
27:                 let k := mload(i) // Key.
28:                 let j := add(i, w) // The slot before the current slot.
29:                 let v := mload(j) // The value of `j`.
30:                 if iszero(gt(v, k)) { continue }
31:                 for {} 1 {} {
32:                     mstore(add(j, 0x20), v)
33:                     j := add(j, w) // `sub(j, 0x20)`.
34:                     v := mload(j)
35:                     if iszero(gt(v, k)) { break }
36:                 }
37:                 mstore(add(j, 0x20), k)
38:             }
39:             mstore(a, n) // Restore the length of `a`.
40:         }
41:     }

/// @notice Library for memory byte buffers with automatic capacity resizing.
/// @author Solady (https://github.com/vectorized/solady/blob/main/src/utils/DynamicBufferLib.sol)
library DynamicBufferLib {
    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/
    /*                          STRUCTS                           */
    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Defines a struct named `DynamicBuffer` to store dynamic byte data.
    /// @param data A bytes array to hold the dynamic data.
    struct DynamicBuffer {
        bytes data;
    }

    /*´:°•.°+.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°•.*•´.*:˚.°*.˚•´.°:°•.°+.*•´.*:*/
    /*                     BUFFER OPERATIONS                      */
    /*.•°:°.´+˚.*°.˚:*.´•*.+°.•°:´*.´•*.•°.•°:°.´:•˚°.*°.˚:*.´+°.•*/

    /// @notice Returns the length of the data stored in the DynamicBuffer.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer whose data length is to be retrieved.
    /// @return uint256 The length of the data stored in the buffer.
    function length(DynamicBuffer memory buffer) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return buffer.data.length;
    }

    /// @notice Reserves additional memory for a DynamicBuffer if the current length is less than the specified minimum.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer to reserve memory for.
    /// @param minimum The minimum length required for the buffer.
    /// @return result The updated DynamicBuffer with potentially increased memory allocation.
    function reserve(DynamicBuffer memory buffer, uint256 minimum)
        internal
        pure
        returns (DynamicBuffer memory result)
    {
        result = buffer;
        if (result.data.length < minimum) {
            /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
            assembly {
                // Calculate the next power of two >= minimum.
                let n := sub(minimum, 1)
                n := or(n, shr(1, n))
                n := or(n, shr(2, n))
                n := or(n, shr(4, n))
                n := or(n, shr(8, n))
                n := or(n, shr(16, n))
                n := or(n, shr(32, n))
                n := add(n, 1)

                // Get the current data pointer and length.
                let d := mload(add(result, 0x20))
                let l := mload(d)

                // Allocate new memory.
                let p := mload(0x40)
                mstore(p, n)
                mstore(0x40, add(add(p, 0x20), n))

                // Copy the data.
                mstore(add(p, 0x20), mload(add(d, 0x20)))
                if gt(l, 0x1f) {
                    let o := 0
                    for {} lt(o, l) { o := add(o, 0x20) } {
                        mstore(add(add(p, 0x20), o), mload(add(add(d, 0x20), o)))
                    }
                }

                // Update the data pointer.
                mstore(add(result, 0x20), p)
            }
        }
    }

    /// @notice Clears the contents of a DynamicBuffer by deallocating its memory and resetting its length.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer to be cleared.
    /// @return result The cleared DynamicBuffer with its length reset to 0.
    function clear(DynamicBuffer memory buffer) internal pure returns (DynamicBuffer memory result) {
        result = buffer;
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let d := mload(add(result, 0x20))
            mstore(d, 0)
        }

    /// @notice Defines a struct named `DynamicBuffer` to store dynamic byte data.
    /// @param data A bytes array to hold the dynamic data.
    struct DynamicBuffer {
        bytes data;
    }

    /// @notice Returns the length of the data stored in the DynamicBuffer.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer whose data length is to be retrieved.
    /// @return uint256 The length of the data stored in the buffer.
    function length(DynamicBuffer memory buffer) internal pure returns (uint256) {
        return buffer.data.length;
    }

    /// @notice Reserves additional memory for a DynamicBuffer if the current length is less than the specified minimum.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer to reserve memory for.
    /// @param minimum The minimum length required for the buffer.
    /// @return result The updated DynamicBuffer with potentially increased memory allocation.
    function reserve(DynamicBuffer memory buffer, uint256 minimum)
        internal
        pure
        returns (DynamicBuffer memory result)
    {
        result = buffer;
        if (result.data.length < minimum) {
            /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
            assembly {
                // Calculate the next power of two >= minimum.
                let n := sub(minimum, 1)
                n := or(n, shr(1, n))
                n := or(n, shr(2, n))
                n := or(n, shr(4, n))
                n := or(n, shr(8, n))
                n := or(n, shr(16, n))
                n := or(n, shr(32, n))
                n := add(n, 1)

                // Get the current data pointer and length.
                let d := mload(add(result, 0x20))
                let l := mload(d)

                // Allocate new memory.
                let p := mload(0x40)
                mstore(p, n)
                mstore(0x40, add(add(p, 0x20), n))

                // Copy the data.
                mstore(add(p, 0x20), mload(add(d, 0x20)))
                if gt(l, 0x1f) {
                    let o := 0
                    for {} lt(o, l) { o := add(o, 0x20) } {
                        mstore(add(add(p, 0x20), o), mload(add(add(d, 0x20), o)))
                    }
                }

                // Update the data pointer.
                mstore(add(result, 0x20), p)
            }
        }
    }

    /// @notice Clears the contents of a DynamicBuffer by deallocating its memory and resetting its length.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer to be cleared.
    /// @return result The cleared DynamicBuffer with its length reset to 0.
    function clear(DynamicBuffer memory buffer) internal pure returns (DynamicBuffer memory result) {
        result = buffer;
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let d := mload(add(result, 0x20))
            mstore(d, 0)
        }
    }

    /// @notice Converts a DynamicBuffer to a string.
    /// @param buffer The DynamicBuffer containing the data to be converted.
    /// @return The string representation of the buffer's data.
    function s(DynamicBuffer memory buffer) internal pure returns (string memory) {
        return string(buffer.data);
    }

    /// @notice Appends data to a dynamic buffer and handles memory reallocation if necessary.
    /// @param buffer The dynamic buffer to which data will be appended.
    /// @param data The data to append to the buffer.
    /// @return result The updated dynamic buffer after appending the data.
    function p(DynamicBuffer memory buffer, bytes memory data)
        internal
        pure
        returns (DynamicBuffer memory result)
    {
        result = buffer;
        if (data.length == 0) return result;
        _append(result.data, data);
    }

    function pBool(DynamicBuffer memory buffer, bool data) internal pure returns (DynamicBuffer memory result) {
        result = buffer;
        /// @solidity memory-safe-assembly
        assembly {
            let d := mload(add(result, 0x20))
            let l := mload(d)
            mstore(add(add(d, 0x20), l), shl(248, iszero(iszero(data))))
            mstore(d, add(l, 1))
        }
    }
